member.name: P:Roblox.Platform.Assets.Places.IGameInstanceConstraint.SocialSlots
member.summary: Number of player slots reserved (of MaxPlayers) for friends of players already in game. If an instance has MaxPlayers = 10 and SocialSlots = 3, then 7 strangers can join that instance. Any other join attempts by strangers will be redirected to other instances. However, friends of anyone already in game can still join that instance, either by matchmaking or by following.
